title: Region of chat channel not visible

issues.title: Region of chat channel not visible
issues.body:
I'm playing as a White Force player who can see Blue Chat, but is not a member of it.

The period at the bottom of the channel is empty.

Steps to reproduce:
* log in as blue player
* create 6 chat message in Blue Chat
* log in as White force player
* examine Blue Chat channel - see space at bottom of channel

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132519949-03edf349-4799-472e-ae39-022c0ea2a6bd.png)

Note: the missing area is the same dimensions as the chat controls:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132521408-6810b71b-3838-4aa5-9f05-10c38f4f5b0f.png)

I've just realised that as a non-member of a channel (White viewing Blue RFI), there is a missing space at the bottom of the column where the `New message` button would be:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132524394-c05380ac-4c16-4fca-ac6a-340506edbf40.png)

comments.body:
Hi @IanMayo, I found the root cause that make the chat region invisible: `client/src/Components/ChatChannel.tsx` ``` state.channels[channelId].observing === false &&
``` in your case, the `state.channels[channelId].observing = true` so the `ChatEntryForm` does not render. I'm not sure if it is right business 🤔

Yeah - player that is "observing" a channel can view the content, but not write messages into it.

But, in the above it's checking for `not observing`. 

It isn't an issue that the chat region is invisible. It's an issue that the space is still allocated to it.  See how the scroll bar only covers ~ 2/3 of the height of the channel.

Ahh, I see this issue is the scrollbar here, the chat area height should be full of the page, right?
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/133072439-64449dae-ffc2-4482-aa32-57a2e336cf45.png)
Yes.  In this instance, if the full height was available, we may not even need the scroll bar.

Hi @IanMayo , for this one ``` I've just realised that as a non-member of a channel (White viewing Blue RFI), there is a missing space at the bottom of the column where the New message button would be: ``` if a non-member of the channel, the bottom should have more space where the new message would be, something like:

I don't think this applies to the COA or RFI channels.

Correct - if a non-member, the messages in the channel should occupy the full height. Space shouldn't be reserved for a component that isn't visible.
